name: Lamotrigine
mechanism: Blocks voltage-gated sodium channels, inhibits glutamate release
dosing: Monotherapy: start 25mg OD for 2 weeks, slow titration. With valproate: start 12.5mg alternate days
interactions: Valproate (↑ lamotrigine levels - halve dose), carbamazepine (↓ levels), OCP (↓ lamotrigine)
monitoring: Watch for rash (especially first 8 weeks), mood, skin reactions
pregnancy: Relatively safer antiepileptic - high dose folic acid recommended
sideEffects: Rash (including Stevens-Johnson syndrome), dizziness, headache, insomnia
clinicalPearls: SLOW titration essential to reduce rash risk. Stop immediately if rash appears. Useful for bipolar depression
indication: Epilepsy (focal and generalised), bipolar disorder (especially depression prevention)
